fact: The Plan national de développement sanitaire 2024-2028, adopted in Council of Ministers on 23 February 2024, sets as a medium-term objective to develop and deploy by end December 2028 a DHIS2 platform integrating all health programmes, with DHIS2 training for data managers at the three levels of the health pyramid, and records that the previous health information software (Infosani) is obsolete and the SNIS globally dysfunctional.
title: Plan national de développement sanitaire du Gabon 2024-2028
